title: Our Weekend
text:
My family has a small apartment in the city. My father, my mother and my two cousins live with us. We have a yellow kitchen and a little balcony with plants.

On Saturdays, we visit my grandmother. She lives near the park. She makes big cakes, and we always eat them together.

questions.text: How many cousins live with the family?
What does the family do on Saturdays?
How does the writer probably feel about visiting the grandmother?
What can we guess about the family's balcony?

vocabulary.definition: a set of rooms for a family to live in, usually in a building
a small area outside a room, high up on a building
the mother of your mother or father

paragraph_translations: Mi familia tiene un apartamento pequeño en la ciudad. Mi padre, mi madre y mis dos primos viven con nosotros. Tenemos una cocina amarilla y un pequeño balcón con plantas.
Los sábados visitamos a mi abuela. Ella vive cerca del parque. Hace pasteles grandes y siempre los comemos juntos.
